spec.title: Memory usage over request
spec.description: containers using more memory than requested are at risk of eviction

spec.expr:
(
    (
        sum by(container, namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{node=~"$node",container!=""})
        -
        sum by(container, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node=~"$node"})
    )
    or
    (
        sum by(container, namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{node=~"$node",container!=""})
    )
) > 0 * 1024 * 1024
sum (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})
sum (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="pods",node=~"$node"})

sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="pods",node=~"$node"})
*
(
    sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",node=~"$node"})
    -
    1
)
/
sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",node=~"$node"})
sum (kube_node_status_capacity{resource="memory",node=~"$node"})
sum (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory",node=~"$node"})
sum (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",node=~"$node"})

sum (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory",node=~"$node"})
-
sum (
    sum by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node=~"$node"})
    * on(namespace, pod) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (
        kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1
    )
)

sum (
    sum by (namespace,pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",node=~"$node"})
    * on(namespace, pod) group_left() max by (namespace, pod) (
        kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1
    )
)
-
sum (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",node=~"$node"})

sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory",node=~"$node"})
*
(
    sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",node=~"$node"})
    -
    1
)
/
sum(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",node=~"$node"})
sum by(node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!="",node=~"$node"}[5m]) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"^(Pending|Running|Terminating)$"} == 1))
sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu",node=~"$node"} * on (namespace,pod) group_left(phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"^(Pending|Running|Terminating)$"} == 1))
sum by(node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu",node=~"$node"})

spec.title: Top CPU over reservation / daily 99 percentile
spec.description: CPU request is more than twice the 99 percentile daily usage, and at least 10m over-reservation

spec.expr:
topk(20,
(
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
    -
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (quantile_over_time(0.99,rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!="",container!=""}[1m])[1d:]))
    > 0.01
) and (
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (quantile_over_time(0.99,rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!="",container!=""}[1m])[1d:]))
    /
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
    < 1
)
)

spec.title: Top CPU under reservation / daily average
spec.description: CPU request is less than the average daily usage, and at least 10m under-reservation

spec.expr:
topk(20,
(
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (avg_over_time(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!=""}[1m])[1d:]))
    -
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
    > 0.010
)
and
(
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
    > 0
)
and
(
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (avg_over_time(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{image!=""}[1m])[1d:]))
    /
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"})
    > 1
)
)

spec.title: Top Memory over reservation / daily percentile
spec.description: Memory request is more than max daily usage, and at least 10Mb over-reservation

spec.expr:
topk(20,
(
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"})
    -
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{image!="",container!=""}[1d:]))
    > 10*1024*1024
) and (
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{image!="",container!=""}[1d:]))
    /
    avg by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"})
    < 1
)
)
